source.sha256_method: sha256 over 7 tables' full unfiltered COPY (ORDER BY code, yearend_date, statementtype) CSV output, each preceded by a 'TABLE:nq_finreport.<name>' header line, concatenated in fixed alphabetical order: bal_b, bal_i, bal_nb, cf, pla_b, pla_i, pla_nb

promotion.serving_dataset_domain_note: dataset is 'financial_facts' (plural, matches packages/financial-facts and this task's naming instruction); domain is 'financial_fact' (singular), the existing aiphabee_core.serving_dataset_domain_check CHECK value added by 20260625002000_hkex_news_ingest_foundation.sql. This is a naming-convention mismatch (plural dataset name, singular domain enum value), not a domain substitution like security_profile's reuse of 'security_master'.
promotion.new_index_required_reason: entity_id lookup uses the leading prefix of the existing serving_record unique index (serving_snapshot_id, entity_type, entity_id, ...)

period_scope.excluded_reason: FinancialFactRow.periodType is a closed "FY"|"H1" union. statementtype F rows with coverperiod != 12 and I rows with coverperiod != 6 are fiscal-year-change stub periods that cannot be truthfully labeled FY or H1, so they are excluded rather than mislabeled. Quarterly filings (Q1/Q3/Q4/Q5) and preliminary (P) results are excluded entirely (no FY/H1 mapping exists).

excluded_row_counts.note: 26120 total F/I rows in pla_nb (and bal_nb) minus 26020 clean-period (F+cp12 or I+cp6) rows = 100 excluded stub rows

metric_excluded.reason: no single rights-pinned vendor column exists for free_cash_flow; it would require deriving cf_ncf_operact minus a capex figure from nq_finreport.bal_nb.capex, a cross-table computed metric, not a 1:1 column projection. This promotion only projects existing FinancialFactMetric values that map cleanly to one vendor column; it does not compute derived metrics.

value_representation.note: Vendor columns (e.g. pla_nb.totalturnover) already contain full, unscaled currency amounts (verified against real Tencent (00700) FY2023 totalturnover=609015000000, i.e. RMB609,015,000,000, matching the public FY2023 revenue figure). Unlike the packages/financial-facts synthetic fixtures (scale=1000000, unit='million'), no scaling is applied here; scale is always 1 and unit is always the literal string 'unit'.

unclaimed_row_shape_fields.reason: no rights-pinned source column exists anywhere in the mirrored Netquity schema (checked nq_finreport.{pla_nb,bal_nb,cf,sup,fr_nb} and nq_compinfo/nq_compprofile*) for accounting standard, a distinct company identity, or a restatement lineage/chain. The live row type (packages/financial-facts LiveFinancialFactRow) omits these fields entirely rather than populating them with an invented constant; this is a different, purpose-built live type, not a reuse of the synthetic FinancialFactRow interface.
unclaimed_row_shape_fields.publishedAt_is_populated: unlike the omitted fields above, publishedAt IS rights-pinned: it is sourced from the statement row's own announce_date column (0 NULLs across all 78060 in-scope pla_nb/bal_nb/cf rows).

bank_insurance_exclusion.marking_mechanism: serving_record with payload.coverage = {status: "unavailable", reason: "..."} and payload.facts = [] (empty array), never a fabricated or partially-derived fact row
bank_insurance_exclusion.cf_shared_table_note: nq_finreport.cf (cash flow) has no bank/insurance variant -- a single table covers every filer type, including banks. An instrument is scoped into the nb promotion by whether it has a qualifying pla_nb or bal_nb row, not by whether cf has rows for it; otherwise a bank-only instrument would get an operating_cash_flow fact with every other metric silently absent, misreading as "this bank has no revenue" instead of "this promotion does not cover banks". Verified 0 instruments exist with cf rows but neither an nb row nor a pla_b/pla_i/bal_b/bal_i row.
bank_insurance_exclusion.verified_sample: HSBC (code=00005, entity_id=hkex_security_00005): present in nq_basicdata.stock and nq_finreport.pla_b, absent from nq_finreport.pla_nb/bal_nb -> promoted with coverage.status="unavailable"

runtime_role.new_grant_required_reason: existing GRANT SELECT is table-level over aiphabee_core.serving_dataset/serving_snapshot/serving_record and already covers new rows/datasets in those tables

web.valuation_derived_metrics_still_blocked: DerivedPanel (P/E and other market_cap-dependent metrics) is untouched by this promotion and stays on the synthetic/blocked path; a live quote/market-cap rights pin is a separate cut
